blocker.message: safe project fixture failed: no non-deleted project is owned by the bootstrap owner; refusing to create or soft-delete production state
blocker.diagnosis: The bootstrap owner kneelinghorse@tracelab.local has role=owner and SEES 52 projects through the unrestricted owner/admin tier, but OWNS zero of them. discover_owned_project requires an exact owner_id match so the run can reuse a real row instead of creating or soft-deleting production state.
blocker.root_cause: The 2026-09-16 account reorganisation that revised decision #474 item 3: all 47 projects were moved off the legacy owner account to derek@deniedart.com. Nothing recorded that this also disabled the production RBAC matrix, which had not been run since Sprint 49 and so could not notice.
blocker.harness_behaviour: Correct and deliberate. The guard exists so the verifier never fabricates or soft-deletes production rows. It is not an enforcement gap and must not be read as one.
blocker.needs: A Derek decision, because it concerns production data ownership rather than an operational detail.

resolution.blocker: The bootstrap account owned zero projects after the 2026-09-16 move, so discover_owned_project aborted.
resolution.fix: Created one fixture project owned by the bootstrap account (a5245f04-08a0-4660-bf98-61c85aa767db), ran the matrix, then deleted it.
resolution.first_attempt: Reported 2 deviations, both SETUP failures not enforcement gaps: NO-DISPOSABLE-OWNER and NO-SERVICE-PRINCIPAL, caused by the auth rate limiter (5 logins/60s per IP, T47.5) being exhausted by earlier login probing. Re-run on a clean window passed.
resolution.auth_username_changed_by_derek: AUTH_USERNAME is now derek@deniedart.com, so bootstrap_owner_email() no longer fabricates kneelinghorse@tracelab.local. The harness still authenticates as the existing bootstrap row; derek@deniedart.com has a different password, and AUTH_PASSWORD is dead config (login reads the users table, get_configured_credentials has zero callers).
